name: Will an expired listing negatively affect the value of my home?

mainEntity.name: Will an expired listing negatively affect the value of my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: An expired listing itself doesn't directly decrease your home's intrinsic value, but it can create a perception among buyers that something is wrong with the property, potentially impacting future offers. To mitigate this, it's crucial to address the reasons for expiration proactively and present a refreshed listing. A new, well-executed marketing strategy and a clear explanation for the re-listing can help overcome any initial buyer skepticism and preserve your home's market perception.
acceptedAnswer.description: An expired listing doesn't inherently decrease value, but it can create negative buyer perceptions. Proactively addressing issues and refreshing the listing helps maintain market perception.
